facts.fact: Desmond Israel of GIMPA Law School, in Adomonline, refers to Ghana's Right to Information Act as an existing law with which the draft bill's defences should be harmonised.

GIMPA Law School's Department of Public Law and Governance filed a submission on 10 November 2025 criticising the draft Misinformation, Disinformation, Hate Speech and Publication of Other Information Bill 2025 as strict liability for speech and executive overreach.
Adomonline says the Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations invited public comments on the draft MDHI Bill 2025, and GIMPA Law School filed a submission on 10 November 2025.
